items.label: DOJ-CIVIL civil: Forest Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
items.detail: Civil False Claims Act settlement announced with the guilty plea; date is the announcement date. The release states more than $313 million in all: a criminal fine of $150 million plus $14 million forfeited (the separate criminal row, $164 million) and 'Forest also will pay over $149 million to resolve allegations under the False Claims Act' (over $88 million to the federal government, over $60 million to the states). The amount here is the stated floor of 'over $149 million'.
